name: Sand Palm
description: Press a palm packed with charged sand against the target so the grains scrape across skin and guard.

name: Dust Shroud
description: Hold a thin cloud of dust around the body so blows land soft and slow against the user.

name: Grain Step
description: Slide one pace on a skid of loose grain that carries the body past a reaching strike.

name: Mote Sense
description: Let drifting motes settle on nearby bodies and read their shape from where the dust lands.

name: Sand Toss
description: Fling a handful of charged sand at the face so the target must turn away.

name: Sand Burst
description: Open the fist at the moment of contact and spray sharp sand across the target's chest.

name: Sand Veil
description: Throw a fan of sand across the target's eyes to break their sight for a breath.

name: Skid Sand
description: Spill sand under the lead foot and slide away from a reaching grip.

name: Grain Guard
description: Brush an incoming blow aside with a sleeve of rough grain that turns it wide of the body.

name: Sole Grind
description: Drag a heel with sand packed on the sole down the target's shin to tear skin and balance.

name: Dust Whorl
description: Spin a small whorl of dust at the target's hands to jar loose their hold.

name: Mote Fade
description: Fade half a pace sideways while a screen of motes hangs where the body stood.

name: Dust Jab
description: Jab two fingers coated in packed dust into the soft hollow of the target's arm.

name: Settling Guard
description: Let a fall of dust gather over the forearms until it thickens into a light guard.

name: Mote Count
description: Breathe out a haze of motes and count the bodies nearby by how the motes curl around them.

name: Dust Blink
description: Snap fine dust at the lashes so the target blinks and loses the line of their strike.

name: Dust Edge
description: Draw the edge of a hand through packed dust so it leaves a hard thin line across the target.

name: Dust Clasp
description: Pack dust around a wrist until the joint clogs and the target cannot easily turn the hand.

name: Sediment Fist
description: Drive a fist wrapped in clinging sediment that weighs down the target's guard.

name: Sediment Slide
description: Skate forward on a slick film of fine sediment laid beneath the feet.

name: Sediment Screen
description: Raise a thin sheet of settled sediment before the chest to take the first strike.

name: Clogging Touch
description: Press sediment into the target's sleeve and joints until their movements turn stiff and slow.

name: Settle Sense
description: Spread a layer of sediment on the floor and read each footfall from the ripples it makes.

name: Sinking Palm
description: Push a palm down so sediment drags at the target's feet and unsettles their stance.

name: Grain Strike
description: Throw a straight blow with a hand full of hard grain that bites on contact.

name: Hard Grain
description: Pack the grains over the forearm until they set hard enough to stop a short blow.

name: Rolling Grain
description: Roll the weight over a bed of loose grain and come up a pace away.

name: Grain Flick
description: Flick a single hard grain off the thumb so it stings the target at a distance.

name: Winnow
description: Fan the arm in a winnowing sweep that blows a strike's force away like chaff.

name: Grain Lock
description: Pour grain into the folds of the target's grip until the fingers jam and cannot close.

name: Quern Hand
description: Grind the heel of the hand in a circle against the target's guard like a millstone.

name: Chaff Reader
description: Toss a pinch of grain and read the air and nearby bodies from how it falls.

name: Shifting Stance
description: Sink into a loose stance on yielding sand qi so the force of a push drains away.

name: Sand Hook
description: Swing a short hook with a curl of sand riding the knuckles into the target's ribs.

name: Sand Roll
description: Roll the shoulders and hips over a swell of sand to slip a pace beyond reach.

name: Sand Spray
description: Spray a wide fan of sand from the palm that pelts the target from chest to brow.

name: Parched Grip
description: Draw moisture from the target's palm with sand qi until their grip cracks and slips.

name: Rasping Hand
description: Drag an open hand across the target's guard so packed grit wears through cloth and skin.

name: Choking Puff
description: Puff a fine dust at the nose and mouth to make the target cough and lose rhythm.

name: Dust Slip
description: Leave a smear of dust at the heel and slip sideways out of a grab.

name: Rough Cloak
description: Wrap the shoulders in a coarse cloak of sand that scrapes at anything striking it.

name: Abrasive Touch
description: Rub the fingertips along the target's forearm and wear a raw patch where the grit passes.

name: Grain Ward
description: Turn a thrust aside on a rolling wedge of grain set against the incoming limb.

name: Dust Trace
description: Follow a target by the faint dust their steps leave hanging in the air.

name: Chaff Throw
description: Throw a pinch of charged chaff that sticks to the lashes and stings the eyes.

name: Sifting Guard
description: Sift a blow through the open fingers so its force spills out to either side.

name: Sieve Step
description: Pass between two attackers like grain through a sieve and come out on the far side.

name: Fine Sift
description: Sift the air through the fingers and read heat and breath from what clings to the hand.

name: Husk Weight
description: Load the target's shoulders with a drift of husks until each step comes heavy and slow.

name: Hull Strike
description: Crack a husk-hard knuckle against the target's elbow where the guard is thinnest.
